issue.title: test_pane_grid_properties::test_outputs_stay_valid trips Hypothesis too_slow health check under the loaded scoped lane

task_type_fields.evidence:
Failed once in scoped check ToolRun 4d441ab8c25555d7b67af8dd266a2c4d on 2026-11-07 (60521 passed / 2 failed, 1h32m wall, host load ~25). Triage classified it FLAKY. Afterward it passed 3/3 serial runs of the whole module on the same tree.

Failure: `hypothesis.errors.FailedHealthCheck: Input generation is slow: Hypothesis only generated 6 valid inputs after 1.02 seconds` at `tests/ace/tui/util/test_pane_grid_properties.py:121` (seed 329690644762878107825480796621819465816).

Root cause: the module's `@given(grids)` tests run with Hypothesis' default health checks. The `_grids` composite draws `sampled_from` over every pane permutation plus nested draws, so on a saturated xdist worker, generating inputs crosses the 1s `too_slow` threshold. This is a health-check failure, not a PaneGrid invariant failure: no example failed an assertion.

Suggested fix: suppress `HealthCheck.too_slow` on this module's grid-strategy tests, as `tests/test_vcs_log_filter_query.py` and `tests/test_plan_filter_query_canonical.py` already do, or make `_grids` cheaper to draw. Fail rate: 1 in 1 loaded full-lane run seen so far; 0 in 3 serial runs.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase tool run check (scoped test lane on a loaded host)

issue.creation_reason: The scoped check lane failed this node on a health check (slow input generation), not an invariant, and no bead owned it; a one-line settings fix keeps it from reddening unrelated checks.
